game_title: The Lost Legacy of C · B and Unix
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber, a mossy sealed door: the shadow ranger must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Continue Gate: Use continue to skip spoiled pickaxes but keep the loop running.
theme: Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber: a mossy sealed door
core_gameplay_loop: Search the archive, examine recovered computing artifacts, and use their evidence to verify the assigned C lesson.
player_objective: Case 6: Find 5 artifacts, read the evidence, and verify three findings about B and Unix.
controls: Select objects in the room. Review discovered objects in Evidence and verify your findings. Tab and Enter select controls. Escape closes a card or pauses.
win_condition: Recover all 5 artifacts and answer all three evidence checks correctly.
lose_condition: The case ends when the available incorrect evidence checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared archive artwork, illustrated artifacts, and Kenney interface audio.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Continue Gate' (Week 4 slot 11), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Moss Door Chamber'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Match the silhouettes in the tray to the objects in the room.

source_player_objective: Protect the supply cache from skeleton miners in Moss Door Chamber: keep the skipped_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 29-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: skipped_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 29-second timer ends.
source_game_title: Continue Gate – Moss Door Chamber Defense
hint: Match an unfound object in the tray to its shape in the room. The Evidence folder keeps every record you uncover.
